intro: Got a bug to report or an idea for a feature? We read every submission — and if it helps us build a better product, we might send a credit your way toward a future payment.

creditBalance.heading: Credit balance
creditBalance.description: Credits earned from feedback and discretionary grants.

steps.heading: Steps to reproduce
steps.description: The exact sequence of actions that leads to the problem, numbered if possible.

actual.heading: Actual behavior
actual.description: What actually happened instead — include any error messages you saw.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: What's missing or frustrating today that this would solve.

solution.heading: Proposed solution
solution.description: Your idea for how this could work, even roughly.

howItWorks.heading: How it should work
howItWorks.description: Walk through it as if explaining to a teammate — what would you click, and what would happen?

anything.heading: Anything on your mind
anything.description: Feedback, ideas, or something else entirely — there's no wrong way to use this one.
